vraiment ton truc,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Tu préfères les randonnées usantes

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Cosa?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Non avrei mai detto che fossi
un tipo da montagna, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Personalmente,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} preferisco nuotare
e mangiare pesce che scarpinare
ad alta quota,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Neee!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Dağ insanı olduğunu hiç

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ben olsam{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} yokuş yukarı yürümek yerine
yüzmeyi ve balık yemeyi her gün
seçerim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ah ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu es plutôt montagne, toi ?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
On ne dirait pas comme ça... {{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est
vrai que la montagne,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} c'est génial !
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Hmm... Fondue, tartiflette,
raclette... Moi, les grands espaces,
ça m'ouvre l'appétit, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ah, sul serio?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} E così tu preferisci
la montagna, eh?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Ma perché non urli
questa passione al mondo intero?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Fossi in te,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} scalerei una montagna e,
raggiunta la cima,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} comincerei a
urlare: {{TAG:0007:000B:}}"{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}VIVA LE MONTAGNEEE!!!{{TAG:0007:0007:}}".
Ricordati di gridare a squarciagola:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0007:000B:}}"{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}VIVA LE MONTAGNEEE!!!{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!"{{TAG:0007:0001:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Occhio al mal di gola,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}So{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}That means you like the
ocean and mountains equally,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Me too. Trying to choose between
them is like choosing between
peanut butter and jelly.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Can't do it!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Les deux ? Je comprends. Moi non
plus en fait, je ne pourrais pas
choisir, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est comme la confiture de fraises
ou la pâte à tartiner.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Impossible de faire un choix !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ah{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}E così ti piacciono il mare e
la montagna allo stesso modo,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Anche a me. Scegliere tra queste
due cose è come dover scegliere tra

DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Das heißt also...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}dass es dir egal ist,
ob du in die Berge oder ans Meer
fährst, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Mir geht's genauso!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Berge und Meer
sind wie Bonbons und Schokolade –
wie soll man sich da entscheiden?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Yani{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Denizi de dağları da
eşit seviyorsun,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ben de. İkisi arasında seçim yapmak
fıstık ezmesiyle reçel arasında seçim yapmak
gibi.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Olmuyor!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Seriously?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} So if you had to choose,
you'd say you like the ocean better,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}But the water in the ocean is so
salty,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you can't even drink it,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}What's more, mountains have snow!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Which means all-you-can-eat
sno-cone action!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah oui ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu préfères la mer. Tu es
comme ça, toi ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Mais pourtant à la mer les glaces
fondent super vite,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} et après on a les
pattes qui collent,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}En montagne, c'est pas un souci !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}En plus, là-bas, de la glace, il y en a
partout !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Echt?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Also – wenn du die Wahl
hättest, würdest du eher ans Meer
fahren als in die Berge, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Aber...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Aber das Wasser im Meer
ist doch so salzig!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das schmeckt
überhaupt nicht,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Außerdem liegt auf den Bergen
Schnee!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}Dann kann man sich Bretter
anschnallen und ins Tal schliddern!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Cidden mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Seçmek zorunda kalsan
denizi tercih edersin yani,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ama deniz suyu o kadar tuzlu ki{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
içemiyorsun bile,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Üstelik dağlarda kar var!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Yani sınırsız karlı dondurma demek!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A huh huh huh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I love the ocean best
too!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's got everything I need:
fish, shrimp, crab, lobsters{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}It's basically a barbecue waiting
to happen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I'm glad we agree on the important
stuff,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Je, je, je!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Yo también prefiero
la playa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} En el mar hay de todo...
gambas, cangrejos, langostas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Básicamente es una mariscada
que espera a que vaya alguien a
cocinarla,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Cocinarías tú todo ese marisco
para mí,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eh eh eh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Anch'io preferisco il mare!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ci trovi dentro di tutto: pesci,
gamberi, granchi, aragoste{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}È come se contenesse una bella
grigliata mista che non vede l'ora di
essere mangiata,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mi fa piacere che siamo d'accordo

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Äh, he he he!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich mag das Meer
auch am liebsten!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Da gibt es Fische,
Krabben, Riesenkraken...
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Lauter hübsche, niedliche Tierchen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich freue mich, dass wir da einer
Meinung sind!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ahaha!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ben de en çok denizi seviyorum!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
İhtiyacım olan her şey orada: balık,
karides, yengeç, ıstakoz{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Resmen kurulmayı bekleyen bir mangal,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Önemli konularda aynı
fikirde olmamıza
sevindim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

Hey,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I have an important question

Sweet
Spicy

Picante

{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'ai une question de la

Piccanti.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}So{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} that either means you like things
that are sweet and spicy,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} or it
means you only like bland food.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}You can be awfully inscrutable
sometimes,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Entonces,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} a ti te gusta la comida

O que te da igual, vamos.

{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Tu aimes forcément le sucré-salé !

IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mmh...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} non capisco se ti piacciono
i cibi dolci e piccanti allo stesso
modo{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} o se preferisci quelli insipidi.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Forse le tue papille gustative

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I like spicy stuff too!{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}} {{TAG:0003:0022:}}Especially
curry that's so hot it makes you
sweat and cry at the same time!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Whew!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}I'm getting sweaty and
hungry just thinking about it,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡A mí también me va el picante!{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0022:}}¡Sobre todo el curry tan picante
que se te caen los lagrimones!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Jolines!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}¡Estoy empezando a sudar
y a tener hambre solo de pensar
en ese curry,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tout comme moi. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Je préfère aussi

Le bar en croûte de sel, les chips et
même la pâte à sel...{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}} Mais rien que
d'y penser, j'ai soif,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Anche a me piace il piccante!{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}} {{TAG:0003:0022:}}
Soprattutto il peperoncino!

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Mmm...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}Mi sta venendo caldo e fame

Brown?

A ver, si yo estuviera
atado a ti con una cuerda,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}

Rouge !

Marron ?

sceglieresti?{{TAG:0008:0003:2200000023000000240000002500000026000000}}

stellst du dir das Band unserer

EN:

our friendship is totally sunny,
right,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I guess it could also mean that our

Il giallo, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0004:}}Il giallo è il colore delle
persone solari, solare proprio come
la nostra amicizia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

gelosia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ma non nel nostro caso,

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tu vois notre amitié en bleu, toi ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
C'est un peu froid comme couleur,
ça, non ?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hmm... C'est aussi la couleur de la
noblesse...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ein blaues Band?{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}}{{TAG:0003:002A:}} Unsere Freund-
schaft ist so was wie der schnellste
Dampfer auf der Transatlantiklinie!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Da guckst du, was?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Ich hab eine Menge Bücher über
alte Schiffe zu Hause!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}A brown string, huh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's like the silk
on an ear of corn,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}So it's pretty delicate,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} but it holds{{TAG:0003:0004:}}
something delicious inside!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Yep,

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Kahverengi bir ip, ha?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mısır koçanındaki

{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Uh...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}so you and I are connected by

{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Oh...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Willst du damit sagen, dass

{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Şey...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}yani seninle beni ucuz bir uçurtma ipi mi
